title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Article 292 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Legislation Law of the People's Republic of China and the needs of judicial practice, deliberated on the meaning of the provisions regarding the methods of service of legal documents in the trial in absentia procedure under Article 292 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and interprets as follows:
"Other methods permitted by the law of the place where the defendant is located" as provided in Article 292 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China refers to various methods of service that are prescribed, recognized, approved, or accepted by the laws, precedents, practices, judicial practices, etc., of the place where the defendant is located, including but not limited to methods of service by mail, public announcement, publication, electronic means, etc.
This is hereby announced.
